title: BigQuery: Secure Query Context, Parquet Geo Export, & JobStatistics2 Breaking Change
summary: BigQuery introduces a new `SecureContext` for queries, enabling secure parameter passing, and adds support for native Parquet Geography type exports. Heads up: `JobStatistics2.referencedLogicalViews` is now read-only, which is a breaking change if you were previously setting this field.
details:
Developers can now leverage a new `SecureContext` object within `JobConfigurationQuery` and `QueryRequest` to pass sensitive, context-specific key-value pairs to queries. These values can be accessed within SQL queries using the `SECURE_CONTEXT()` function, allowing for dynamic query behavior based on secure inputs. Additionally, BigQuery export jobs now support exporting native Parquet Geography types by setting `nativeGeographyExportEnabled` to `true` in `JobConfigurationExtract`.

Breaking Change Alert: The `referencedLogicalViews` property within the `JobStatistics2` schema has been explicitly marked as read-only. If your applications or tools were previously attempting to set or modify this field, they will now encounter errors. Please update your code to reflect that this field is output-only.
